children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Replicate only supported components, remove avoidable single points of failure, and test disruption against explicit objectives.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Replica count alone is not HA; edge, database, storage, scheduling capacity, and leader behavior must survive the same failure.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Publish replica safety, leader election, migration ownership, session behavior, and remaining single points of failure.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: List supported replica counts and leader-election behavior.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: State database requirements and embedded-mode limitations.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Separate cluster-scoped dependencies from application replicas.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Place safe replicas and durable dependencies across nodes, zones, and independent failure domains.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Use anti-affinity, topology spread, and appropriate disruption budgets.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Provide redundant edge, supported HA database, storage, DNS, and backups.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Reserve failover capacity instead of saturating every node.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Drain or terminate one dependency at a time and measure availability, reconciliation continuity, handoff, sessions, jobs, and audit.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Replicate only replica-safe parts (Operator 2+; API stays at 1)

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  One domain loss leaves edge, control plane, DB, storage, capacity

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Test leader, DB, ingress, and node loss; record RTO/RPO
